probes.contract_source: A task's declared reward basis defines the components that the comprehensive evaluator must score; selecting the default comprehensive entry point must not omit a declared component.
A tool declared read-only may return information but must not change the database state used for environment grading.
JSON integer and whole-valued floating-point spellings denote the same documented numeric amount and therefore must produce the same deterministic graded state.
A stored full-duplex simulation is represented by ticks and a full-duplex mode marker; offline rescoring must evaluate that representation under the same communication mode as live grading.
Offline rescoring of a historical trajectory must preserve its tool-induced terminal state when only the recorded tool-result rendering has drifted.
